summary: Lease-push guardrail removed: agents may lease-push any non-protected branch from any session (new allowForcePush mode lease, repo set to it)

options.description: Add allowForcePush mode lease (lease push to any non-protected branch from any cwd and role); set this repo to it; leaseOnOwnBranch stays the adopter default
Keep the binding; add only a planner filing-branch exception
Keep the binding; operator hand-pushes docs and filing branches

body: Operator ruling 2026-10-21 13:45Z. The task-worktree binding on lease pushes (cwd under .worktrees/, .active-task sentinel, directory/branch agreement, one executor claim, hierarchy role) was added inline by an agent while fixing an executor push problem; the operator never asked for it and it has only added process friction: docs, filing and RFC branches can never be refreshed by an agent, so every red one costs an operator hand push or a re-filed PR (closed PRs are wasted work; #1780 and #1779 today). The force-with-lease semantics already prevent clobbering a head the pusher has not seen, and main/master/protected branches stay refused in every mode. Class: governance weakening, operator-answered; implemented by AISDLC-1005 (PR #1826).
